_comment: Packages counted by scripts/npm-downloads.mjs. Add a line when you publish one; the script reports anything npm lists under the maintainer that is missing here, but will not count it, because a search-index gap must not silently change a published total. The concord-engine-mcp and shadowjoin-mcp launchers were published 2026-11-12 and withdrawn the same day, so they are not listed: a package that no longer exists 404s at registry.npmjs.org and the script throws rather than counting it as zero.
